regions.today: Dry and warm this evening with light winds.
regions.tonight: A dry night with clear spells at first, then cloudier later with mist and fog patches developing. Mild and humid with temperatures not falling below 13 to 16 degrees, in light variable breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Any mist or fog will soon lift in the morning with spells of summer sunshine developing widely. Very warm or hot with highs of 23 to 27 degrees. Winds will be mostly light southwesterly but local sea breezes will develop in the afternoon.
regions.solar_uv: High in sunshine on Thursday and Friday, otherwise moderate.
